reviews.name: 한****
reviews.content: 아이보리색 있는데 예뻐서 차콜은 선물했어요!! 선물 받은 사람도 좋아하구요 ㅎㅎ 저도 대만족중이에요 ㅎㅎ 예뻐서 어디든 잘 어울리고 다들 강아지 산책가방이라고는 생각 못하는 디자인이라 더 맘에 들어요 ㅋㅋ 산책이나 나들이 갈때도 잘 쓰지만 요즘은 출근할때 매일 매는 중이에요 !
reviews.content_en: They had an ivory color, and it looked so pretty so I gifted the charcoal one!! The person who received it loves it too hehe. I'm super satisfied too hehe. It's so pretty it goes well anywhere, and I love it even more because it doesn't look like a dog walking bag at all lol. I use it well for walks and outings, but these days I'm using it every day when I go to work!

reviews.name: 예****
reviews.content:
출근길에 리뷰남기려고 후다닥 찍은 사진,, 강지 산책 말고 제 일상용으로 쓰고 있어요!!! 저처럼 보부상백은 싫은데 잡다하게 짐은 많고 게다가 가방안에서 맨날 물건찾으라 오백년 걸린다면 강추합니다!! 앞이랑 옆 포켓에 안쪽애도 앞뒤로 포켓 두개씩.. 수납혜자백이고 특히 유용한건 뒤쪽 작은 포켓이에요!! 아이폰 미니나 카드지갑 들어가기 딱좋은 사이즈고 뒤쪽에 있어서 더 뭔가 안심... 맨날 지갑찾느라 바빳는데 아예 자리 지정해두니까 잃어버릴 일 없이 편해요 ㅎㅎ 

컬러 진자 고민 만이 하다가 베이지 햇는데ㅠ 블루가 넘 아른거려서 조만간 블루도 지를거같아요 ㄷㄷㄷ
reviews.content_en:
A quick photo I took on my way to work to leave this review,, I'm using it for my daily life, not just for Gangji's walks!!! If you're like me and hate looking like a street vendor with lots of random stuff, and you spend forever rummaging through your bag looking for things, I totally recommend it!! With pockets on the front and sides, and even inside pockets with two on the front and back... this is a storage powerhouse bag and what's especially useful is the small pocket in the back!! It's the perfect size for an iPhone mini or card wallet, and since it's in the back it feels more secure... I used to be busy looking for my wallet all the time but now that I have a designated spot for it, it's so convenient I never lose it hehe.

I spent so long agonizing over the color and went with beige ㅠ but the blue is so eye-catching I think I'll get the blue one soon too lol

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
펫페어에서 구경만 했는데 눈에 넘 아른거려서 바잇미에서 구매했어요!! 완존 대박 만족합니다...
어떤 옷에 들던 잘 어울리고 대박인건 아이패드도 들어가요
사진은 저렇게 찍었지만 가로로 넣으면 쏙 들어가고 아이패드 외에 파우치도 두세개도 더 들어가요 진짜 안에 엄청 크게 잘 빠진거 같아요! 포켓도 많아서 작은건 또 따로 수납하면 되더라구요
바리바리스타라 항상 짐이 많아서.. 이렇게 예쁜데 짐도 많이 들어가고 튼튼해서 최근에 산 가방중에 제일 만족합니다!!
강아지랑 나갈때도 엄청 편할거같아요 감사합니다 잘 쓸게요 💛
reviews.content_en:
I only looked at it at a pet fair but it was so eye-catching I bought it from BITE ME!! I'm completely blown away satisfied...
It goes well with any outfit and the amazing part is that an iPad fits in it too.
I took the photo like that but if you put it horizontally it slides right in, and besides the iPad, two or three pouches fit inside too. It really feels like the inside is incredibly spacious! And since there are so many pockets, I can store smaller items separately too.
Since I'm a barista and always have lots of stuff with me.. this is so pretty but fits so much and is sturdy, so it's my favorite bag I've bought recently!!
I think it'll be super convenient when I go out with my dog too. Thank you, I'll use it well 💛

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
지인 추천으로 구매한 가방이에요.ᐟ 
겉보기엔 작고 아담하지만 가방 속에는 이것저것 다 들어가는 아주 위대한 가방쓰...🩷
빗부터 시작해서 발밤, 똥비닐, 물티슈 그리고 제 화장품과 핸드폰까지 ㅠㅠ 미쳐요 아쥬🤭
원단도 튼튼해서 오랫동안 쓸 것 같아요. 감사합니다!🩷
reviews.content_en:
I bought this bag on the recommendation of a friend.ᐟ
It looks small and compact on the outside but inside this bag fits absolutely everything, what an amazing bag...🩷
Starting from a brush, paw balm, poop bags, wet wipes and even my cosmetics and phone ㅠㅠ it's crazy amazing 🤭
The material is sturdy too so I think I'll use it for a long time. Thank you!🩷

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
강아지는 없지만 그냥 제가 들고다니려고 샀어용
컬러가 넘 예뻐요~~ 쨍한 파란색인데 부담스럽지 않고
여러계절에 두루두루 들기 좋을거같아요~
수납력도 좋고 특히 포켓이 많아서 너무 편해요!
reviews.content_en:
I don't have a dog but I just bought it for myself to carry around.
The color is so pretty~~ it's a vibrant blue but doesn't feel heavy
It'll be great to carry in many different seasons~
Great storage capacity and especially with so many pockets it's super convenient!

reviews.name: 채****
reviews.content: 배송 빨라요 오자마자 개없이 들고 나갔는데 산책가방 안같아서 좋아요. 포켓이 많아서 넘좋음!!! 파우치같은거 따로 안들고다녀도 분리해서 넣을 수있어서 좋아요 손잡이가 길어서 숄더로도 멜 수있는데 어케 메든 다 맘에 들어요^.^ 굿
reviews.content_en: Shipping is fast. I took it out right away and didn't look like a dog walking bag which is great. So many pockets!! Love it!!! I don't need to carry a separate pouch since I can organize things separately in it. The handles are long so I can wear it on my shoulder too, and no matter how I wear it it looks good ^.^ Good!

reviews.name: 꼬****
reviews.content:
포켓 많고 디자인이랑 크기 재질까지 너무 맘에 들어요😍
가벼워서 좋고 예쁜 파랑이라서 휘뚜루마뚜루 잘들고 다닐거 같아요 최고!
reviews.content_en:
Lots of pockets and I love the design, size, and material so much😍
It's light and the pretty blue color makes me want to carry it everywhere! Best!

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content: 가방이 부들부들하고 튼튼해요! 수납도 많이돼서 저는 여행때 들고 다녔습니다ㅎㅎ 너뮤 예쁘고 데일리로 쓰기에도 좋은거 같아욤
reviews.content_en: The bag is soft and sturdy! With lots of storage, I've used it for traveling hehe. It's so pretty and seems like a great daily bag too!

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
너무 예뻐요오 폭신폭신하고 귀여울뻔더러 수납력도 좋아요 
강아지가방 같지 않아서 데일리하게도 잘쓸 것 같아요.
reviews.content_en:
So pretty! It's plush and cute, and it has great storage capacity too.
Since it doesn't look like a dog bag, it seems like it'll work well as a daily bag.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
진짜 활용도 좋고 요물딱진 가방이에요💖
안에 수납 포켓이 네 개가 있어서 자잘한 짐 넣기도 좋고
무엇보다 너무 편하고 예뻐요💖
reviews.content_en:
It's really versatile and such a useful bag 💖
There are four storage pockets inside so it's great for small items,
and most importantly it's so convenient and pretty 💖

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 가볍고 수납공간이 넉넉해서 바리바리스타인 저한테 딱좋아요 그냥 출근가방으로도 써요
reviews.content_en: It's light and has plenty of storage space, which is perfect for me as a barista. I even use it as my work commute bag.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 예뻐요 어디 데리고 나갈때 들고가기 딱 좋아요
reviews.content_en: It's pretty and perfect to carry when taking my dog out.

reviews.name: 햇****
reviews.content_en: Shipping is fast and it's pretty!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 여름에 파란색 미니타운백 잘들고다녔고. 가을겨울에 들려고 차콜사려고했는데 마침 딱! 세일하길래 바로 구입했어요! . 둘다 예쁜데 요게 사이드포켓이 여러개라서 더 맘에 듭니다!
reviews.content_en: I used the blue mini tote well in the summer and was planning to get the charcoal for fall/winter and it happened to be on sale so I bought it right away! Both are pretty but this one has multiple side pockets so I like it even more!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
강아지 산책할 때도 쓰는데, 강아지 없이 혼자 외출할 때도 요긴하게 들고 있어요!
심플하면서도 깔끔한 디자인이라 친구들한테 말 안하면 펫 브랜드 가방인지 모르더라고요!
특히 흔한 블랙이 아닌 은은한 챠콜색이라 무채색러버에게 포인트로 들기 좋습니다!
reviews.content_en:
I use it when walking my dog, but it's also handy to carry on solo outings without the dog!
With its simple and clean design, friends don't realize it's a pet brand bag unless I tell them!
Especially since it's a subtle charcoal color instead of the usual black, it's great as an accent piece for us neutral-tone lovers!

reviews.name: 수****
reviews.content_en: It's so plush and cute! Shipping is fast!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content_en: I bought it as a walking bag but it's also great to carry in my daily life!
